verdict.rationale: Groq documents a deprecations policy covering models and endpoints. It commits to shutdown dates, lists recommended replacements, defines production-vs-preview lifecycle stages and offers migration support; a subscribable API changelog backs it up. The API is versioned through the /openai/v1 path. Missing for 10: any versioning scheme beyond the single fixed v1 path (no header- or date-based pinning), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the deprecation commitments are honored in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: When we announce that a model or endpoint is being deprecated, we will provide a shutdown date on which the model or endpoint will no longer be accessible
All API deprecations along with recommended replacements are listed below
A reverse-chronological API changelog with RSS and email subscription
